direction.principle: One clear benefit per screenshot, grounded in real app captures.

optimization.name: SpotClock 2.0 · First impression

treatments.name: Time first
treatments.hypothesis: Leading with an easy parking setup improves conversion.

treatments.name: Saved spot first
treatments.hypothesis: Leading with a remembered parking spot improves conversion.

optimization.runPlan: Start only after version 2.0 is live and the new creatives are approved. Review Apple confidence and conversion uplift after sufficient traffic; allow 14–28 days, up to Apple’s 90-day maximum. Do not declare a winner from low-volume early results.
optimization.testVariable: Screenshot order; all screenshots use the same design and copy.
optimization.additionalCreativeAlternatives: Four locally exported first-slide headline concepts are provided in Marketing/Exports; they are not part of the draft ordering experiment.
requiresBeforeStart: Replace legacy creatives on every draft with native Pro Max/iPad assets when the required simulator models are available.
Release version 2.0 after Apple approves the build and media.
Activate the experiment and collect real conversion data.

captureBlocker: Installed iOS 27.1 runtime supports iPhone Duo only. Native Pro Max and 13-inch iPad captures are still required before release.
remoteSync: 2.0 draft listing updated; both custom pages and both treatments populated and order-verified.
